title: Thora Early Water Melon - 2x Mini Plug Plants
description:
Organic, Sweet & Compact Mini Watermelon for Your Garden!


KEY FEATURES
• Organic 'Thora BIO' variety, free from synthetic pesticides and fertilisers [easyseeds.eu]
• Extra-early ripening with high sugar content, suitable for cooler climates [easyseeds.eu]
• Compact growth habit, perfect for small gardens, greenhouses, or pots [easyseeds.eu]
• Produces deep red, juicy, intensely sweet flesh with very few seeds [easyseeds.eu]
• Reliable yield of 2-4 kg mini watermelons, even in shorter summers [easyseeds.eu]


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Citrullus lanatus 'Thora BIO'
Colour: Dark green rind with subtle lighter stripes; deep red flesh [easyseeds.eu]
Season: Summer (fruiting)
Growth Habit: Compact, creeping, vigorous [easyseeds.eu]
Flavour: Intensely sweet, juicy, fine texture, almost fibre-free [easyseeds.eu]
Time to Harvest: Early maturing, reliable harvest even in shorter summers [easyseeds.eu]


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun (at least 6-8 hours daily) [easyseeds.eu]
Soil: Airy, rich in organic matter, well-drained [easyseeds.eu]
Watering: Regular and even watering, especially during fruit development; water directly at the roots [easyseeds.eu]
Spacing: 80-100 cm between plants for compact growth [easyseeds.eu]
Height: 30-45 cm (creeping plant) [easyseeds.eu]
Spread: Mainly grows in width (creeping plant) [easyseeds.eu]
Hardiness: Suitable for UK cultivation, best in greenhouse or polytunnel [rhs.org.uk]


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in a sunny location in well-drained, organically rich soil. Consider a greenhouse or polytunnel in the UK for best results [rhs.org.uk].
• Water regularly and consistently, especially when fruits are developing, avoiding overhead watering [easyseeds.eu].
• Use organic mulch or compost to maintain soil temperature and moisture, promoting early growth [easyseeds.eu].
• Feed with potassium-rich compost or organic fertilisers during fruit set to encourage larger, sweeter fruits [easyseeds.eu].
• Optimal growth temperature is 24-32 °C; ensure good ventilation in hot weather to prevent scorching [easyseeds.eu], [rhs.org.uk].
